restaurantName: A Tribute To Nature at The Jumeirah Carlton Tower
address: The Jumeirah Carlton Tower , One Cadogan Place, Knightsbridge,SW1X 9PY
bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 - Award of Excellence  A tribute to nature, inspired by Highgrove Gardens  The Jumeirah Carlton Tower in Knightsbridge created an exciting new take on Afternoon Tea experience, inspired by the botanics and flora of iconic Highgrove Gardens.  The Afternoon Tea offers a menu with unexpected pairings, beginning with savouries, followed by a selection of 4 scones with matching preserves, and concluding with a beautiful array of patisseries and cakes.  Each piece is a sophisticated display of flavour, taking guests on a surprising journey through pastry world. Working with seasonal, locally sourced produce, the new menu explores and celebrates the best ingredients available in England and is a tribute to nature.  Afternoon Tea at Jumeirah Carlton Tower is served in the beautifully decorated Chinoiserie Tea Room. It is available daily starting at 12:30 pm with the last sitting at 04:00 pm, at a price of £75 per person
